top_signals.title: The Bond Market Getting Closer to Sounding Alarm on Economy
top_signals.summary: The bond market is on the brink of signaling that a series of Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes will start shifting the narrative toward the risk that the US economy stalls out.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Higher Bond Yields Are Raising Doubts About Europe’s Stock Rally
top_signals.summary: Rising global bond yields are fueling skepticism about Europe’s equity rally, as investors worry that fiscal and inflation risks are causing cracks in what has so far been a resilient economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Navy stands up hub to prepare unmanned systems for combat
top_signals.summary: U.S. Chief of Naval Operations Adm. Daryl Caudle announced a new autonomous development center to train sailors and test new technology.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
